tweetText: The trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI is raising questions about the trustworthiness of CEO Sam Altman. This matters because trust is crucial for the future of AI development and governance. via TechCrunch AI

Graduation speeches in 2026 might want to skip the AI topic, as it struggles to inspire hope among students. This highlights growing concerns about AI's impact on the future workforce and society. via TechCrunch AI

Automakers are ramping up their AI skills to stay competitive in the evolving automotive industry. This shift is crucial as AI will drive future innovations in safety, efficiency, and user experience. via TechCrunch AI

Apple's revamped Siri in iOS 27 will let users auto-delete chat histories, offering options to save them for up to a year. This move aims to enhance privacy and differentiate Siri from competitors as AI concerns grow. via The Verge AI

Eric Schmidt faced boos from University of Arizona students during his AI-focused commencement speech. Their reaction highlights growing concerns about AI's impact on jobs and the future. via The Verge AI

McDonald's started using AI chatbots at drive-thrus in 2021, piloting the tech in Chicago. This innovation marks a shift in how we interact with fast food, hinting at a future where AI is more integrated into daily experiences. via The Verge AI
